Here's why lifting weights is mandatory if you're taking weight loss medication.

If you're a beginner, start with five minutes of bodyweight resistance training at home every day. You don't need a gym, and you don't need any weights. Then as you progress, increase the time bit by bit. Five minutes is a great place to start.

Go to AbsByAI.com: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=keep-your-muscle&utm_content=sl12-a-weightlifting

Full video: How To Keep Your Muscle While You Lose Fat, on my channel.

The opening includes labeled AI-generated B-roll and an AI-generated version of my own voice.
